result.summary: Wrote lib/letflow/design/req519-enforced-writers-and-flag-on.md (design only). Proposed four sub-PRs: 2e-a (mode read under lock A, reconcile result type, writer registry and AST scan, scope_required refusal and binding.refused, NO-ROW reports), 2e-b (IdP sync suppression with a no-widening rule, pending_scope dedup from stored data, scope_delta on group_member audits), 2f-a (OnGate, ScopedApprovers, ShadowWindow, counts_by_day, Audit.latest_matching, RefusedAudit; flag still unsettable) and 2f-b (parse_mode on, transition table, interactive tenant-wide TENANT_ADMIN authority, C-1 walk test, end-to-end suite). Findings: AC 1 misses the seeding and TAM nil->P writers (seeding refusal would halt the all-tenant RoleBackfill sweep); audit has no action filter; counts_between cannot give per-day totals so counts_by_day is added; T0 comes from the audit chain; check_reason re-key kept minimal; AC 8 narrows PUT (token and platform-tenant PLATFORM_ADMIN lose it); AC 10 scoped-approver definition over-blocks relative to the F1 exemption; C-1 literal is already satisfied on main by the 518 AC 21 rulings (#2817), the wider tenant-level read gap is a documented census with no reclassification in 519; no tasks.scope_node_id writer needed; on is safe but not useful in production until module scope declarations and the task scope writer exist. 9 requirement amendments RA-1..RA-9, 10 SEC rulings S-1..S-10, 42 mutants. REWORK r1 (CDV FAIL step-02): G1 typed suppressed sync result via new Identity.sync_role_claims_report/3 sibling (existing export unchanged, no new RoleScopeGrants export); G2 Backfill in an enforced tenant skips repair, gap check and audit without error, dry-run and sweep report skipped_enforced; G3 completeness scan narrowed to the six AC functions plus Backfill.run, registry scanned rows by call site plus indirect rows checked by T-C2; lows: mode_under_lock! returns :off for a schema without a tenants row, copy_members M-f, TAM skip also skips legacy removal and token rewrite (S-1), integrity test in 2f-a, RA-10; mutants MU-43..MU-46. REWORK r2 (SEC design gate PASS_WITH_FINDINGS step-04): C-1 mode_under_lock! raises in production for malformed prefix or missing tenants row, lenient :off only behind a test-only config key (replaces S-1b); C-2 raised mode read rolls back, sweeps report that tenant; C-3 group-bound roles read after lock A, routing roles never widen; C-4 gate fact 4 counts interactive explicit admins only (no token owners, no flagged service principals); C-5 constant log line on flip 500; C-6 platform-tenant-on test; C-7 ruling ids, per-PR SEC verdict list, ON_IN_PRODUCTION text in sections 6 and 4.10; folded S-1 audit key, S-3 behaviour-change list, S-5 scans, RA-1 reachability, RA-6 before 2f-b, advisories A-1..A-8; mutants MU-47..MU-53.
